items.quote: The most successful agents I know all understand this truth about objections. "I need to think about it" doesn't mean no.
items.statement: "I need to think about it" doesn't mean no.

items.quote: "The timing isn't right" doesn't mean never.
items.statement: "The timing isn't right" doesn't mean never.

items.quote: "I've decided to invest in my Country" doesn't mean they won't change their mind.
items.statement: "I've decided to invest in my Country" doesn't mean they won't change their mind.

items.quote: Every objection is information about their current situation, not their permanent position.
items.statement: Every objection is information about their current situation, not their permanent position.

items.quote: People change jobs, get promotions, inherit money, have life events.
items.statement: People change jobs, get promotions, inherit money, have life events.

items.quote: The "no" today might be the "yes" in 6 months.
items.statement: The "no" today might be the "yes" in 6 months.

overview: Insights from an agent about handling objections in sales interactions.
